Table 10-5  Key Nutrition Recommendations for Peptic Ulcer Disease
•  Limit intake of caffeine-containing beverages and foods including coffee, tea, iced tea, 
colas, and chocolate.
•  Avoid alcohol, especially on an empty stomach.
•  Don’t skip meals.
•  Avoid eating spicy foods, fried foods, and citrus fruits as these foods may worsen symptoms.
•  Avoid other foods or drinks that cause discomfort.
Source: Lisa Hark, PhD, RD and Darwin Deen, MD, MS, 2012. Used with permission.

electrolyte transport within the epithelium. It may be caused by enterotoxins, intesti-
